title: Expedited: Patch ION DAO Accounting and Quarantine Legacy Claims
summary:
## Action
Atomically store reviewed ION DAO v0.0.2 code and migrate the adminless live contract at `osmo1k8re7jwz6rnnwrktnejdwkwnncte7ek7gt29gvnl3sdrg9mtnqkse6nmqm`.

## Why now
Proposals 22-39 record 662 ION of legacy deposits against 9 ION of normally retained base. Their ordinary close/execute window begins `2026-07-17 11:09:01 UTC`. The patch must execute first to quarantine those claims.

## Effect and limits
The patch fixes future deposit accounting and blocks claims for proposals created before or in the migration block. It does **not** reconstruct historical payers, distribute treasury funds, or settle reconciliation.
